traceability.notes: Story docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md defines a maintenance toolkit (detect, update, batch, verify, report, and safe CLI behavior) for traceability annotations. The codebase contains a complete maintenance subsystem (src/maintenance/*) with explicit traceability back to this story and its REQ-MAINT-* requirements. All required behaviors are covered by focused unit tests, CLI integration tests, and performance tests, all of which pass in the current Jest run. Documentation in README.md and user-docs/api-reference.md provides clear usage and behavior descriptions for both the programmatic API and the `traceability-maint` CLI. Error handling for missing roots, invalid flags, filesystem permission errors, and unsafe paths is implemented and validated. Taken together, this satisfies all listed acceptance criteria and the per-requirement definitions for this story.
